# SOP-P3-L2-03 First-article inspection - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03  
Related: ECN-2026-017, SB-1015, SOP-P3-L2-04

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Verify ECN-2026-017 disposition applied to the work order.  
   1.2 Confirm EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 are on the current equipment list.  
   1.3 Ensure lubrication for shot blast is per parts list: The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463.  
   1.4 Confirm heat treat setup matches SOP-P3-L2-04 and SB-1015 where referenced.

2. First-article inspection sequence
   2.1 Load first-article blank into EQ-P3-L2-RR02 per machine setup checklist.  
   2.2 Record machine program ID and operator initials on the inspection record.  
   2.3 After rolling, transfer part to EQ-P3-L2-SB01 for shot blast using approved fixture. Verify CFW-LUB-463 application is current and documented.  
   2.4 Move part to EQ-P3-L2-HT03 for heat treat. Monitor process parameters and note quench timing: The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds. Record actual delay on the first-article form.

3. Inspection criteria
   3.1 Perform dimensional checks per work order drawing and record all readings on the first-article form.  
   3.2 Surface condition and finish must comply with SB-1015 criteria. Document any nonconformances and escalate per ECN-2026-017.

4. Nonconformance and rework
   4.1 If any measurement or surface criteria fail, stop the run and follow disposition in ECN-2026-017.  
   4.2 Rework authorization requires sign-off from Quality and Production leads.

5. PPE
   5.1 Required PPE: safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and protective footwear. Comply with plant PPE policy.

6. Sign-off
   6.1 Operator: ____________________  Date: __________  
   6.2 Quality Inspector: ____________________  Date: __________  
   6.3 Production Supervisor: ____________________  Date: __________

Related documents: ECN-2026-017, SB-1015, SOP-P3-L2-04
